change_summary: Enable new payment flow (Stripe v2 integration) for 100% of users via feature flag. Previously tested at 5% for 1 week.
diff_or_config:
--- a/flags/payments.yaml
+++ b/flags/payments.yaml
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 new_payment_flow:
   enabled: true
-  rollout_percentage: 5
+  rollout_percentage: 100
   targeting:
     - all_users
service_context: checkout-service processes $2M daily GMV. New payment flow uses Stripe v2 API with different error handling. 5% rollout showed 0.1% higher failure rate than v1.
deployment_plan: Update feature flag config to 100%. Immediate effect, no deployment needed.
observability_evidence: Payment success rate dashboard: grafana.internal/d/checkout-payments. Stripe webhook latency panel available.
alerting_evidence: Alert: payment_failure_rate > 2% for 5min triggers PagerDuty. Alert: checkout_latency_p99 > 3s.
blast_radius: All checkout users globally, $2M daily GMV at risk

seeded_gaps.description: Jumping from 5% to 100% with no intermediate stages
No rollback plan - how to revert flag quickly if issues at 100%
No owner or on-call for the rollout
No SLO impact assessment despite known 0.1% higher failure rate
